visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, flowing dark hair is captured from a back-view perspective as she walks away down a city street at night. She wears a sleeveless green tank top with a white collar and black shorts. To her left, several cars are parked along the curb, and a red traffic light glows in the distance above the road. The street is lit by overhead lamps, creating bright spots on the asphalt. (2) The woman maintains a steady, rhythmic pace, her arms swinging slightly as she moves. In her right hand, she loosely holds a dark smartphone. The camera follows her closely, matching her walking speed. On the right sidewalk, a grey electrical box and a 'No Parking' sign are visible. The atmosphere is that of a typical urban night, with various shop signs and building lights in the background. (3) The woman suddenly spins around to face the camera, revealing a bright, wide smile and squinted eyes indicating genuine amusement. She begins to run playfully toward the camera, her hair tossing in the air. Large white subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen, and a bold title overlay remains at the top. The lighting on her face is clear and warm from the nearby streetlights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice with a clear, conversational tone speaks in Mandarin, making an observation about the walking speed of a girl. The voice is well-projected with moderate arousal. In the background, the faint, continuous hum of a city night provides a low-level ambient floor, while the distinct, percussive sound of shoes hitting the pavement creates a rhythmic pattern. (2) The male speaker begins to count 'Yi, Er' (One, Two) in sync with the audible footstep transients. His pitch variability increases, adopting a playful, teasing cadence. Each vocalization is sharp and enunciated. There is no background music, allowing the dry, close-miked quality of the voice and the rhythmic footsteps to dominate the acoustic space. (3) The male voice suddenly increases in volume and intensity, shouting 'Li Ding!' (Attention!) with a sharp rising-falling intonation. Immediately, the acoustic texture shifts as a female voice enters the mix, emitting a high-pitched, energetic burst of melodic laughter. The laughter has a rich harmonic structure and high valence, blending with the sound of rapid, lighter footsteps as the interaction becomes more dynamic.
